Scenario: Verify page title and primary entry points
Steps: Open /; inspect title heading and Masuk and Mulai Belajar Gratis links
Expected Result: Expected title and links are visible and target authentication
Actual Result: Title heading and entry links observed in desktop browser

Scenario: Verify each grade card opens grade-specific authentication
Steps: Open /; inspect Kelas 1 through Kelas 6 links
Expected Result: Each card links to /auth?grade=N
Actual Result: All six grade-specific links observed

Scenario: Verify mobile landing page does not overflow horizontally
Steps: Open / at mobile viewport; compare document width to viewport
Expected Result: No horizontal overflow
Actual Result: Measured document width did not exceed the viewport

Scenario: Verify login fields are labeled and required
Steps: Open /auth; inspect Email and Password fields
Expected Result: Email and password controls have recognizable labels and required validation
Actual Result: Email and password labels and required attributes observed

Scenario: Submit login with empty fields
Steps: Open /auth; submit without entering values
Expected Result: Form remains on authentication page and does not log in
Actual Result: Page remained on /auth; no visible inline validation message was observed

Scenario: Submit malformed email
Steps: Enter malformed email and submit
Expected Result: Native email validation prevents submission
Actual Result: Native validity was false and the form remained on /auth

Scenario: Verify registration form and grade choices
Steps: Switch to registration and inspect fields and grade choices
Expected Result: Registration mode exposes Nama Email Password and six grade options
Actual Result: Registration view and all six choices observed; no account was created

Scenario: Sign in with owner-provided test account
Steps: Submit provided credentials once and verify dashboard heading
Expected Result: Successful login reaches dashboard
Actual Result: Login reached /dashboard and dashboard content rendered

Scenario: Reject incorrect credentials
Steps: Submit an incorrect password once
Expected Result: Authentication remains unsuccessful and displays a useful error
Actual Result: Not attempted to avoid account lockout or unnecessary failed-login events

Scenario: Verify logout and protected dashboard redirect
Steps: Use account action to log out; open /dashboard
Expected Result: User returns to public page and protected route redirects to /auth
Actual Result: Account action returned home; direct /dashboard navigation redirected to /auth

Scenario: Verify dashboard and read-only feature routes

Expected Result: Each discovered route renders its observed feature heading
Actual Result: Routes rendered; lesson and currency actions were not invoked

Scenario: Change leaderboard metric tab
Steps: Open leaderboard and select Koin tab
Expected Result: Selected tab changes and remains selected
Actual Result: Automated assertion confirmed Koin tab has aria-selected=true

Expected Result: Back returns to the dashboard after each feature page
